name: Watercolor Storybook
description: A hand-painted field journal: warm cold-press paper, translucent watercolor washes that bleed at the edges (SVG turbulence and displacement), blooms of pigment that breathe, a soft serif title over a painted swash and handwritten notes. Elements bleed in from a blur, the camera sways slowly and scenes soak through each other in a blotchy wash dissolve. Calm, curious and gentle. No emoji.
prompt_hint: Write 8-12 calm scenes (4-6 s each) like pages of a nature or field journal. Every scene: title.kicker as a short handwritten note and title.main as a gentle serif headline; visual.type "illustration" with 1-3 airy elements: icon (big, size l) for the subject, svg sketches, timeline or flow for cycles and processes, card for a definition, counter for one real number. Avoid dense panels and code. Never use emoji.
